accepted_decisions.summary: CodeWiki UX is terminal-first through Pi TUI, chat, and focused /wiki-* commands.
The standalone browser Control Room/web UI is deprecated and should be removed through a validated cleanup task.
Do not migrate deprecated web UI architecture rendering to YAML; remove web-specific Mermaid parser/code instead.
Agents should have an ASCII/Unicode visual expression layer backed by skills plus deterministic renderers and specific commands.
Terminal visuals are focused lenses, not full raw graph renderers; source truth remains in KB/roadmap/builds/validation/code/Git.
architecture.mmd should be removed from active KB source after cleanup; architecture.yaml remains canonical.

knowledge_changes: Created .codewiki/kb/system/terminal-ui.md with terminal-first system contract, command-triggered surfaces, visual grammars, focus rule, and web removal boundary.
Created .codewiki/kb/product/uis/terminal.md with terminal-first product UX expectations.
Marked browser Control Room product/system docs deprecated and redirected to terminal UI contracts.
Updated product overview success signals and related docs for terminal-first surfaces.
Updated system overview, file-structure, API, API vNext, extension, diagrams README, board/status/map docs for terminal-first direction and browser deprecation.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Terminal UI docs created; browser UI docs marked deprecated.
Terminal UI cleanup rules say not to migrate deprecated web UI rendering unless needed for removal.
/wiki-ui documented as deprecated pending removal/deprecation message.
Product UI docs now point active UX at terminal-first surfaces.
Web UI source/test/dependency cleanup boundary documented.
Agent visual expression and source-backed terminal visuals documented.
Skill plus deterministic renderer/commands split documented; no wiki_visualize mega-tool.
MVP visual grammars and focus rule documented.
architecture.yaml remains canonical; architecture.mmd cleanup/removal boundary documented.
Terminal renderers derive from YAML/graph; Mermaid optional export only.
Active overview/file-structure links point to diagrams/architecture.yaml.
Web/architecture cleanup bounded; broader stale cleanup deferred to scoped tasks.

product_impact: Product UX direction changes from browser Control Room/second screen to terminal-first chat, Pi TUI panels, and focused command-triggered visual surfaces.
Agent visual expression becomes product value: source-backed ASCII/Unicode boards, traces, diagrams, matrices, and cards.
system_impact: Browser UI is deprecated and slated for removal.
Extension/API/docs updated to stop treating /wiki-ui/browser UI as active direction.
Diagram rendering target is terminal/YAML/graph lens first; mmd/browser parser cleanup becomes executable work.
downstream_planning_questions: Plan a validated task to remove or deprecate /wiki-ui, src/ui/web, browser Control Room tests, README docs, and unused browser dependencies.
Plan a validated task to remove .codewiki/kb/system/architecture.mmd and update active references to architecture.yaml after web UI code no longer needs it.
Plan a terminal visual renderer/skill task for board/tree/sequence/state/layered_graph/trace_chain/matrix patterns.
Plan API/command surface for /wiki board, /wiki diagram, /wiki trace, and /wiki runtime after renderer/data foundations are scoped.
Plan a validated task to remove or deprecate /wiki-ui, src/ui/web, browser Control Room tests, README docs, and unused browser dependencies.
Plan a validated task to remove .codewiki/kb/system/architecture.mmd and update active references to architecture.yaml after web UI code no longer needs it.
Plan a terminal visual renderer/skill task for board/tree/sequence/state/layered_graph/trace_chain/matrix patterns.
Plan API/command surface for /wiki board, /wiki diagram, /wiki trace, and /wiki runtime after renderer/data foundations are scoped.
assumptions: Current users are maintainers, agents, extension/workflow authors, and terminal-native technical users.
Web UI can be removed without losing core product value because CodeWiki backend/API and Pi TUI/chat remain active.
Historic builds/validation/archive refs should not be rewritten during cleanup.
non_goals: Do not implement terminal renderer in this decision.
Do not delete web UI code in this decision build.
Do not render full raw graph by default.
Do not make terminal render output canonical truth.
risks: Removing web UI is high-impact and must be planned/validated with package tests and dependency proof.
Some README/source docs remain to update in implementation cleanup tasks.
Command names such as /wiki board, /wiki diagram, and /wiki trace are accepted direction but not implemented yet.
